items.title: Ndivia Jetson AGX Orin
items.content:
## Build kernel
### Install toolchain
[jetson-linux-r3644](https://developer.nvidia.com/embedded/jetson-linux-r3644)  
tar -xjvf aarch64--glibc--stable-2022.08-1.tar.bz2 -C /opt/toolchains/nvidia/  

### Install required packages
sudo apt install build-essential bc flex bison libssl-dev zstd  

### Download sample root file system
cd /home/victor/working_directory/nvidia/JetPack_6.2.1_Linux_JETSON_AGX_ORIN_TARGETS/Linux_for_Tegra/  
sudo ./apply_binaries.sh

### Download driver package
cd /home/victor/working_directory/nvidia/JetPack_6.2.1_Linux_JETSON_AGX_ORIN_TARGETS/Linux_for_Tegra/source/  
./source_sync.sh -k -t jetson_36.4.4  

### Modify kernel config
vim kernel/kernel-jammy-src/arch/arm64/configs/defconfig  

### Set environment variables
export ARCH=arm64  
export TOOLCHAIN_DIR=/opt/toolchains/nvidia/aarch64--glibc--stable-2022.08-1/bin  
export CROSS_COMPILE_AARCH64_PATH=${TOOLCHAIN_DIR}  
export PATH=${TOOLCHAIN_DIR}:${PATH}  
export CROSS_COMPILE=${CROSS_COMPILE_AARCH64_PATH}/aarch64-buildroot-linux-gnu-  
export INSTALL_PATH=~/working_directory/nvidia/JetPack_6.2.1_Linux_JETSON_AGX_ORIN_TARGETS  
export INSTALL_MOD_PATH=${INSTALL_PATH}/Linux_for_Tegra/rootfs/  
export KERNEL_HEADERS=${INSTALL_PATH}/Linux_for_Tegra/source/kernel/kernel-jammy-src  

### Build and install kernel and in-tree modules
make -C kernel  
sudo -E make install -C kernel  
cp -av kernel/kernel-jammy-src/arch/arm64/boot/Image ${INSTALL_PATH}/Linux_for_Tegra/kernel/Image  

### Build and install out-of-tree modules
make modules  
sudo -E make modules_install  
cd ..  
sudo ./tools/l4t_update_initrd.sh  

### Build the DTBs
cd source  
make dtbs  
cp -av kernel-devicetree/generic-dts/dtbs/* ${INSTALL_PATH}/Linux_for_Tegra/kernel/dtb/  

## Reflash device
### Internal eMMC
sudo ./flash.sh jetson-agx-orin-devkit internal

### SSD
sudo ./flash.sh jetson-agx-orin-devkit nvme0n1p1


### USB
sudo ./flash.sh jetson-agx-orin-devkit sda1

### SD card
sudo ./flash.sh jetson-agx-orin-devkit mmcblk0p1
